items.heading: Laap
details: Key ingredients: minced meat, lime juice, toasted rice powder, herbs, chili
Cook minced meat (or use raw for laap dip if traditional) until just done.
Toss with lime juice, fish sauce and chili to taste.
Fold in toasted rice powder and a generous amount of fresh herbs.
Serve with sticky rice and fresh lettuce leaves.

items.heading: Tam Mak Hoong
details: Key ingredients: green papaya, chili, lime, fish sauce, tomato
Shred unripe green papaya into thin strips.
Pound chili and garlic in a mortar, then add tomato.
Add the papaya and toss with fish sauce and lime juice.
Pound briefly to bruise and mix, then serve with sticky rice.

items.heading: Sticky Rice
details: Ingredients: rice, vegetables or protein, onion/garlic, oil, seasoning and water/stock.
Cook the rice by absorption or steaming.
Sauté the other ingredients separately, combine and season to taste.

items.heading: Khao Poon
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
